ai.overview: The Philadelphia 76ers bring the lineal championship belt to Charlotte on October 31st, 2026, facing a Hornets team hungry to reclaim hardware they've held 35 times before. Philadelphia captured the belt in their most recent victory, a 98–93 win over New York, and now must defend it for the first time in this reign. With the 76ers holding a 5-1 record and the Hornets at 3-3, this marks the seventh time these franchises have met with the belt on the line.
key_matchups: Philadelphia's two-game winning streak versus Charlotte's two-game skid—momentum could prove decisive
The 76ers' 5-1 start contrasts sharply with Charlotte's inconsistent 3-3 form, including a 79–95 loss in their last outing
Recent history favors Philadelphia, winners of four of the last five meetings including a 118-114 decision in March 2026
ai.betting_angles: Philadelphia enters on a two-game winning streak with an impressive 5-1 record, while Charlotte has dropped consecutive games and sits at .500. The 76ers have won four of the last five head-to-head matchups, though the Elo model interestingly tags them as underdogs on the road. Charlotte's recent 79–95 loss suggests offensive struggles, while Philadelphia posted 98 points in a tight defensive battle against New York.
ai.prediction_writeup: Philadelphia's superior form—5-1 overall with wins in their last two—gives them the edge over a Charlotte squad that has lost back-to-back games and allowed 95 points in their most recent outing. The 76ers have owned this matchup lately, winning four of five including a 118-114 road victory at Charlotte in March. While the Elo model sees Charlotte as favorites at home, Philadelphia's consistency and recent defensive solidity in the 98–93 win over New York suggest they're built to protect the belt. The 76ers escape Charlotte with their first successful defense.
